note: Visible tests cover numeric comparison and one pre-release tag against its release; only the hidden tests cover leading zeros, tags against each other, numbers before tags, every kind of invalid text and the type check.

twin_breaks.rule: a part with a sign, a space or a letter (`+1.2.3`, `1. 2.3`, `1.x.0`)
a tag with any other character (`1.2.0-rc.1`)
